decisions.decision: Pass SourceControlSettings {repository, baseUrl} through the registry factory
decisions.why: source-control adapters received no settings, so a self-hosted address had no route; the SourceControlProvider interface itself stays unchanged (FR-001)
decisions.rejected: encoding the host into the repository id

decisions.decision: One validateBaseUrl/isLoopbackHost in src/config.ts for both baseUrl and the existing tracker site
decisions.why: one tested rule; exact localhost match refuses localhost.example.com

decisions.decision: Platform ids gitlab and gitlab-issues with bearer auth
decisions.why: GitLab accepts Authorization: Bearer PAT, so credentials.ts is unchanged
decisions.rejected: gitlab-self-managed id or a PRIVATE-TOKEN scheme

decisions.decision: Read-only layer uses redirect manual and follows same-origin 3xx up to 5 hops
decisions.why: ADR 0002: the credential must never reach another origin

decisions.decision: Live git fetch gets the token from a test-only credential store in a temp HOME
decisions.why: the product already relies on the reviewer git credentials and gitEnv passes HOME; no token enters product code, clone config or URLs
decisions.rejected: injecting the stored token into git fetch from the product

decisions.decision: Per-run reviewer is a Reporter member; the no-access issue lives in a separate private project
decisions.why: Reporters can see confidential issues, so a confidential issue would not prove no access
decisions.rejected: confidential issue in a project the reviewer belongs to

decisions.decision: Live files are test/gitlab/*.test.ts gated by a /api/v4/version probe; test:gitlab adds PRWB_GITLAB_REQUIRED via node --env-file
decisions.why: npm test picks them up and skips; --env-file is cross-platform without a shell (P.4)
decisions.rejected: adding them to test:live, which never skips

decisions.decision: Contract suites become exported runners fed by a per-target data record, including the no-access reason
decisions.why: live expectations are only known after seeding; a data value avoids per-platform branches (SC-001)
decisions.rejected: keeping module constants and special-casing GitLab

decisions.decision: Adapter accepts an optional pageSize used only by live paging tests
decisions.why: proves paging and truncation with a few MRs instead of hundreds

decisions.decision: Each run lives in prwb-it/<run>, a subgroup of a shared never-deleted prwb-it group
decisions.why: GitLab 19 permanently removes only subgroups; a deleted top-level group keeps the run name for 30 days, breaking SC-004

decisions.decision: The seeder pushes the first commit instead of initialize_with_readme
decisions.why: with parallel project creation the README commit times out in Gitaly and GitLab leaves the repo empty without an error

decisions.decision: Cleanup removal waits allow 180s; seeding waits stay at 30s
decisions.why: GitLab removes users and, under load, groups in background jobs that take about two minutes

decisions.decision: US2 AS5 asserts the reopened note, not an open session
decisions.why: 001 VO-076 keeps a closed-then-reopened session read-only with reopened on platform; this feature does not change product behaviour
decisions.rejected: changing session state handling for reopen

decisions.decision: Fixture contract targets call adapter factories directly, not the registry
decisions.why: keeps registry.ts and context.ts owned by US1 alone

decisions.decision: Recording test replays a full set of adapter calls rather than the whole runSourceControlContract
decisions.why: the shared runner needs fork, deleted and unauthorized scenarios a single recording does not hold; same-results replay proves the format

plan.summary: Planned GitLab adapters, neutral baseUrl config, same-origin redirects, and a test-only seeder with skip-or-fail live suites

approach: Add gitlab and gitlab-issues adapters behind the existing registry and read-only layer, with a neutral baseUrl validated by one https-or-loopback rule and same-origin-only redirects. A test-only PlatformSeeder (GitLab implementation) seeds per-run data and a non-admin reviewer, and the existing contract suites become data-driven runners that run live under test/gitlab, skipping under npm test and failing under test:gitlab.
